options.content:
Physical Server Hardware Monitoring SOLARWINDS SAM • HARDWARE HEALTH
LIVE MONITORING

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    ISNULL(MachineType, 'Unknown') AS [DeviceType],
    COUNT(NodeID) AS [DeviceCount]
FROM Nodes
WHERE UnManaged = 0
  AND Caption <> IP_Address 
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote}) 
GROUP BY MachineType
ORDER BY [DeviceCount] DESC

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN n.ObjectSubType = 'WMI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [WMI], 
    SUM(CASE WHEN n.ObjectSubType LIKE '%SNMP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [SNMP], 
    SUM(CASE WHEN n.ObjectSubType = 'Agent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Agent], 
    SUM(CASE WHEN n.ObjectSubType = 'ICMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Ping], 
    SUM(CASE WHEN n.ObjectSubType NOT IN ('WMI','Agent','ICMP') AND n.ObjectSubType NOT LIKE '%SNMP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Other] 
FROM NodesData n
LEFT JOIN VIM_VirtualMachines vim ON n.NodeID = vim.NodeID
WHERE n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
  /* LOGIC MATCHING INVENTORY EXACTLY */
  AND vim.NodeID IS NULL 
  AND (
      n.IsServer = 1 
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%'
  )

SELECT COUNT(n.NodeID) 
FROM NodesData n
LEFT JOIN VIM_VirtualMachines vim ON n.NodeID = vim.NodeID
WHERE vim.NodeID IS NULL  -- Matches Physical-Only Logic
  AND (
      n.IsServer = 1 
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%' 
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%'    -- Added missing filter
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%' -- Added missing filter
  )
  AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT COUNT(NodeID) 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status = 2 
  AND UnManaged = 0 
  AND LastSystemUpTimePollUtc > DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) 
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT COUNT(h_item.ID) as CriticalHardware 
FROM Nodes n
JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo h_info ON n.NodeID = h_info.NetObjectID AND h_info.NetObjectType = 'N'
JOIN HWH_HardwareItem h_item ON h_info.ID = h_item.HardwareInfoID
WHERE n.Status <> 2 
AND n.UnManaged = 0 
AND h_item.Status = 14
AND h_item.IsDisabled = 0 
AND h_item.IsDeleted = 0 
AND h_info.IsDisabled = 0 
AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT 
    n.Caption AS [Server], 
    c.Name AS [Category], 
    hi.DisplayName AS [Component], 
    hi.Value AS [Value], 
    'CRITICAL' AS [Status] 
FROM HWH_HardwareItem hi 
JOIN HWH_HardwareCategoryStatus hcs ON hi.HardwareCategoryStatusID = hcs.ID 
JOIN APM_HardwareCategory c ON hcs.HardwareCategoryID = c.ID 
JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo hinf ON hcs.HardwareInfoID = hinf.ID 
JOIN Nodes n ON hinf.NetObjectID = n.NodeID 
WHERE hi.Status IN (2, 14) 
  AND n.UnManaged = 0 
  AND hi.IsDisabled = 0 -- Filter out disabled sensors
  AND hi.IsDeleted = 0  -- Filter out removed sensors
  AND hinf.IsDisabled = 0 -- Ensure hardware polling is active for the node
  AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote}) 
ORDER BY n.Caption ASC

SELECT 
    c.Name AS [HardwareType], 
    COUNT(hi.ID) AS [FailureCount]
FROM HWH_HardwareItem hi
JOIN HWH_HardwareCategoryStatus hcs ON hi.HardwareCategoryStatusID = hcs.ID
JOIN APM_HardwareCategory c ON hcs.HardwareCategoryID = c.ID
JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo hinf ON hcs.HardwareInfoID = hinf.ID
JOIN Nodes n ON hinf.NetObjectID = n.NodeID
WHERE n.UnManaged = 0 
  AND hi.Status IN (2, 14) 
  AND hi.IsDisabled = 0 
  AND hi.IsDeleted = 0 
  AND hinf.IsDisabled = 0 
  AND n.Caption LIKE '%[a-zA-Z]%' 
  AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote}) 
GROUP BY c.Name;

WITH NodeStatusMapping AS (
    SELECT 
        n.NodeID,
        CASE 
            /* Bucket 1: Down Nodes */
            WHEN n.Status = 2 THEN 'Node Down'
            
            /* Bucket 2: Hardware Failures (Sensor checks) */
            WHEN n.Status = 1 
                 AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM HWH_HardwareItem hi
                    JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo hinf ON hi.HardwareInfoID = hinf.ID
                    WHERE hinf.NetObjectID = n.NodeID 
                      AND hinf.NetObjectType = 'N'
                      AND hi.Status IN (2, 14)
                      AND hi.IsDisabled = 0 
                      AND hi.IsDeleted = 0
                      AND hinf.IsDisabled = 0
                 ) THEN 'Hardware Failure'
            
            /* Bucket 3: Healthy */
            WHEN n.Status = 1 THEN 'Healthy'
            
            /* Catch-all for Unmanaged (Status 9) or Warning */
            ELSE 'Other Issues'
        END AS NodeHealth
    FROM NodesData n
    LEFT JOIN VIM_VirtualMachines vim ON n.NodeID = vim.NodeID
    WHERE n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
      -- PHYSICAL SERVER GATEKEEPER LOGIC
      AND vim.NodeID IS NULL 
      AND (
          n.IsServer = 1 
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%'
      )
)
SELECT 
    NodeHealth,
    COUNT(NodeID) AS Total
FROM NodeStatusMapping
GROUP BY NodeHealth
ORDER BY Total DESC;

/* SOLARWINDS SAM: PHYSICAL SERVER HEALTH (GRAFANA CORRECTED) */
WITH NodeStatusMapping AS (
    SELECT 
        n.NodeID,
        n.Caption,
        n.IP_Address,
        n.MachineType,
        n.Status,
        n.StatusDescription,
        /* COLUMNS NOW VALID VIA 'Nodes' VIEW */
        ISNULL(n.CPULoad, 0) AS CPULoad,
        ISNULL(n.PercentMemoryUsed, 0) AS MemoryUsed,
        
        CASE 
            WHEN n.Status = 2 THEN 'Node Down'
            WHEN n.Status = 1 
                 AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM HWH_HardwareItem hi
                    JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo hinf ON hi.HardwareInfoID = hinf.ID
                    WHERE hinf.NetObjectID = n.NodeID 
                      AND hinf.NetObjectType = 'N'
                      AND hi.Status IN (2, 14)
                      AND hi.IsDisabled = 0 
                      AND hi.IsDeleted = 0
                      AND hinf.IsDisabled = 0
                 ) THEN 'Hardware Failure'
            WHEN n.Status = 1 THEN 'Healthy'
            ELSE 'Other Issues'
        END AS NodeHealth
    FROM Nodes n  /* <--- CHANGED FROM NodesData TO Nodes */
    LEFT JOIN VIM_VirtualMachines vim ON n.NodeID = vim.NodeID
    WHERE n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
      AND vim.NodeID IS NULL 
      AND (
          n.IsServer = 1 
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%'
          OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%'
      )
)
SELECT 
    nsm.NodeHealth AS [Category],
    nsm.Caption AS [Node Name],
    nsm.IP_Address AS [IP Address],
    nsm.CPULoad AS [CPU],
    nsm.MemoryUsed AS [RAM],
    nsm.MachineType AS [Hardware Model],
    
    CASE 
        WHEN nsm.NodeHealth = 'Hardware Failure' THEN 
            ISNULL(
                STUFF((
                    SELECT '; ' + CAST(hi.DisplayName AS VARCHAR(100)) + ' (' + CAST(hi.OriginalStatus AS VARCHAR(50)) + ')'
                    FROM HWH_HardwareItem hi
                    JOIN HWH_HardwareInfo hinf ON hi.HardwareInfoID = hinf.ID
                    WHERE hinf.NetObjectID = nsm.NodeID 
                      AND hi.Status IN (2, 14)
                      AND hi.IsDisabled = 0
                      AND hi.IsDeleted = 0
                    FOR XML PATH('')
                ), 1, 2, '')
            , 'Check Hardware Health Tab')
        WHEN nsm.NodeHealth = 'Node Down' THEN 'Node is unreachable (ICMP/SNMP failure)'
        WHEN nsm.NodeHealth = 'Other Issues' THEN nsm.StatusDescription
        ELSE 'System Optimal'
    END AS [Status Details],
    
    '🔍 View' AS [Action]

FROM NodeStatusMapping nsm
ORDER BY 
    CASE nsm.NodeHealth 
        WHEN 'Node Down' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Hardware Failure' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Other Issues' THEN 3
        ELSE 4 
    END,
    nsm.Caption;

SELECT COUNT(NodeID) 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status = 2 
  AND UnManaged = 0 
  AND LastSystemUpTimePollUtc > DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) 
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT 
    n.Caption AS [Server],
    n.IP_Address AS [IP Address],
    n.MachineType AS [Model/OS],
    'DOWN' AS [Status],
    n.StatusDescription AS [Details],
    n.LastSystemUpTimePollUtc AS [Last Contact]
FROM Nodes n
WHERE 
    n.Status = 2 
    AND n.UnManaged = 0 
    /* Filter to show only servers seen in the last 30 days (Excludes Ghosts) */
    AND n.LastSystemUpTimePollUtc > DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE())
    AND n.Caption NOT LIKE '%[0-9]%.[0-9]%.[0-9]%.[0-9]%'
    AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
ORDER BY n.Caption

panels.title: 🚨 ACTIVE DOWN SERVER DETAILS (Seen in last 30d)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(NodeID) 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status = 2 
  AND UnManaged = 0 
  AND (LastSystemUpTimePollUtc < DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) OR LastSystemUpTimePollUtc IS NULL)
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT TOP 100
    Caption AS [Server],
    IP_Address AS [IP],
    /* Use LastSystemUpTimePollUtc because we verified it exists in your DB */
    DATEDIFF(day, ISNULL(LastSystemUpTimePollUtc, DATEADD(year, -2, GETDATE())), GETDATE()) AS [Days_Offline],
    LastSystemUpTimePollUtc AS [Last_Contact]
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status = 2 -- Down
  AND UnManaged = 0 -- Still being monitored
  /* If LastContact is NULL (Ping only) OR older than 30 days */
  AND (LastSystemUpTimePollUtc < DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) OR LastSystemUpTimePollUtc IS NULL)
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
ORDER BY [Days_Offline] DESC

SELECT COUNT(NodeID) as BrokenConfig 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE (MachineType = 'Unknown' OR Vendor = 'Unknown') 
  AND UnManaged = 0 
  AND ObjectSubType IN ('WMI', 'SNMP')
  AND Status <> 2 
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT 
    Caption AS [Server],
    IP_Address AS [IP Address],
    ObjectSubType AS [Method],
    StatusDescription AS [Error Message],
    /* Smart Analysis of the Error Message */
    CASE 
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%RPC%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%0x800706BA%' THEN '🔥 FIREWALL: Check Ports 135/445'
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Access Denied%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%Login%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%Invalid password%' THEN '🔑 CREDENTIALS: Check Account/Password'
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Timeout%' THEN '⏳ NETWORK: Latency or Packet Loss'
        ELSE '⚠️ WMI REPAIR: Rebuild WMI Repository'
    END AS [Suggested Fix]
FROM Nodes 
WHERE (MachineType = 'Unknown' OR Vendor = 'Unknown') 
  AND UnManaged = 0 
  AND ObjectSubType IN ('WMI', 'SNMP')
  AND Status <> 2 
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote}) 
ORDER BY Caption

SELECT 
  'Unknown Devices' as [Category],
  SUM(CASE WHEN ObjectSubType = 'ICMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Ping Only (ICMP)],
  SUM(CASE WHEN ObjectSubType IN ('WMI', 'SNMP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Config Failure (WMI/SNMP)]
FROM Nodes 
WHERE (MachineType = 'Unknown' OR Vendor = 'Unknown') 
  AND UnManaged = 0
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT 
    Caption AS [Server Name],
    IP_Address AS [IP Address],
    ObjectSubType AS [Method],
    /* Smart Status Classification */
    CASE 
        WHEN ObjectSubType = 'ICMP' THEN 'BLIND: PING ONLY (No Agent)'
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%RPC%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%0x800706BA%' THEN 'FIREWALL BLOCK (Port 135/445)'
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Access Denied%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%Login%' THEN 'AUTH FAILURE (Bad Creds)'
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Timeout%' THEN 'NETWORK TIMEOUT'
        ELSE 'CHECK CONFIG'
    END AS [Root Cause]
FROM Nodes 
WHERE (MachineType = 'Unknown' OR Vendor = 'Unknown') 
  AND UnManaged = 0
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
/* NEW SORTING LOGIC */
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    /* 1. FIREWALL IS CRITICAL PRIORITY */
    WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%RPC%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%0x800706BA%' THEN 1
    /* 2. Other WMI/SNMP Errors */
    WHEN ObjectSubType IN ('WMI', 'SNMP') THEN 2
    /* 3. ICMP/Ping Only (Lowest) */
    ELSE 3
  END ASC,
  Caption ASC

panels.title: 📋 DETAILED LIST: ALL BLIND SPOTS (Firewall Priority)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Access Denied%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%Login%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [⛔ AUTH FAILURE],
    SUM(CASE WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%RPC%' OR StatusDescription LIKE '%0x800706BA%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [🧱 FIREWALL BLOCK],
    SUM(CASE WHEN ObjectSubType = 'ICMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [⚠️ BLIND: PING ONLY],
    SUM(CASE WHEN StatusDescription LIKE '%Timeout%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [⏳ NETWORK TIMEOUT],
    /* Catch-all for remaining items */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN ObjectSubType <> 'ICMP' 
        AND StatusDescription NOT LIKE '%Access Denied%' 
        AND StatusDescription NOT LIKE '%Login%' 
        AND StatusDescription NOT LIKE '%RPC%' 
        AND StatusDescription NOT LIKE '%0x800706BA%' 
        AND StatusDescription NOT LIKE '%Timeout%' 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [❔ CHECK CONFIG]
FROM Nodes 
WHERE (MachineType = 'Unknown' OR Vendor = 'Unknown') 
  AND UnManaged = 0
  AND Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})

SELECT 
    n.Caption AS [Server],
    disk.Model AS [DiskModel],
    disk.SerialNumber,
    CAST((disk.CapacityB / 1073741824.0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS [Size_GB]
FROM AssetInventory_HardDrive disk
JOIN Nodes n ON disk.NodeID = n.NodeID
WHERE 
    n.UnManaged = 0
    AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
ORDER BY disk.Model

SELECT 
    n.Caption AS [Server Name],
    n.IP_Address AS [IP Address],
    -- Standardized Physical Categorization
    CASE 
        WHEN n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%' THEN 'Hyper-V Host (Physical)'
        WHEN n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%' OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%' THEN 'VMware Host (Physical)'
        WHEN n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%' THEN 'Infrastructure (Physical)'
        ELSE 'Physical Standalone Server'
    END AS [Category],
    n.MachineType AS [OS / Model],
    n.Vendor,
    n.StatusDescription AS [Current Status]
FROM NodesData n
LEFT JOIN VIM_VirtualMachines vim ON n.NodeID = vim.NodeID
WHERE vim.NodeID IS NULL -- Exclude Virtual Guests
  AND (
      n.IsServer = 1 
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Hyper-V%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%ESX%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%VMware%'
      OR n.MachineType LIKE '%Cisco UCS%'
  )
  AND n.Caption IN (${Node:singlequote})
ORDER BY [Category], n.Caption;
